review:
Fortune Hit'n Roll is a 5x5, 40-line Aztec slot. Wilds can turn into Forged Wilds, which become sticky and move up or down the reel each spin, gaining +1 to their multiplier with every move until they leave the grid.

Three scatters award nine free spins, in which every wild becomes sticky and can appear in any position. The RTP is 96.57%, and Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win on the page. The moving, growing wilds make the base game more dynamic than most line slots.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
